record_type_quote:
We conducted a replication and extension of foundational work by Willer et al. (2013)
             on the link between masculinity threat and political attitudes with a larger, nationally
             representative sample of U.S. adults.

targets.authors: Willer, Robb, Bridget Conlon, Christabel L Rogalin and Michael T Wojnowicz
targets.title: Overdoing Gender: A Test of the Masculine Overcompensation Thesis.
targets.evidence_quote:
There are four studies in the Willer et al. (2013) paper. Our replication only concerns the first two, both
             of which were lab experiments.
targets.outcome_quote:
We conducted a replication and extension of foundational work by Willer et al. (2013)
             on the link between masculinity threat and political attitudes with a larger, nationally
             representative sample of U.S. adults. We do not find evidence that the original effects
             replicate.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion gives an overall failure verdict for the original effects. Both original experiments belong to one paper; newly added outcomes and alternative threat conditions are extensions, not separate original targets. Checks using new data do not make this a reproduction.

reasoning: Matching DOI, title and both authors verified on PDF first page. Completed experiment reports new nationally representative data. Preregistered report is not a result-free plan. Conclusion mapped to discussion as the permitted section vocabulary.
